releaseNotes:
- Dual Calendar Hub: Gregorian (AD) and Bikram Sambat (BS) bi-directional converter & festival engine
- VoIP Calling: Full-duplex raw 16-bit PCM streaming with dynamic jitter buffering & DTMF dialpad
- Android Home Screen Widgets: Interactive Agenda, Tasks, Budget & Quick Action launchers
- Offline-First Architecture: High-performance SQLite 3 with Drift ORM reactive persistence
- Hardware Biometric Shield: Fingerprint / Face Unlock & background App Lock Overlay
- Developer Diagnostics: Secret 10-tap unlock with database inspector & memory monitors
newFeatures: Dual Calendar System: Seamless AD & BS calendar converter with Nepali holidays and Tithi astronomical calculations.
VoIP Voice Calling & Audio Pipeline: Low-latency peer-to-peer calling with soft limiting, ringtones, and DTMF dialer.
Interactive Android Home Widgets: Glance widgets for Agenda, Tasks, Budget, and fast action launchers.
Hardware Biometrics & App Lock: Secure app content with fingerprint/face biometric protection and background lock overlay.
SQLite 3 + Drift Persistence: Reactive, offline-first local database caching for blazing fast performance.
